title: Light Switch reverts to scheduled mode following Power Toys update, even if previous state was set manually.

judgment.rationale: The issue supplies a specific update sequence and source shows in-memory override state reset on initial settings load, but an update's exact lifecycle and desired persistence need verification.
evidence: The reporter manually toggles to dark during scheduled light time and says a PowerToys update then restores scheduled light instead of preserving the manual choice.
A diagnostic ZIP and a detailed scheduling sequence were supplied.

LightSwitchStateManager stores isManualOverride in its state and clears it when loading the first settings snapshot: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c/src/modules/LightSwitch/LightSwitchService/LightSwitchStateManager.cpp.

fix_assessment.rationale: The issue supplies a specific update sequence and source shows in-memory override state reset on initial settings load, but an update's exact lifecycle and desired persistence need verification.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve Light Switch manual override through updates
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A restarted service may lose its in-memory override and apply the schedule; an updater-specific restart and desired expiration behavior still require confirmation.
plan: Reproduce a manual dark override during a scheduled light interval, then compare service restart and an actual update.
If restart loses the override, design persistence that preserves the user's choice only until its intended next schedule boundary and accounts for settings changes.
Add tests for restart during an override, crossed boundaries, changed schedule and both system and application themes.
verification: An update during the interval preserves the manual theme until the next applicable boundary; normal scheduling resumes afterwards.

reproduce.title: Test manual override across an update
prerequisites: A fixed-hours schedule with the current time in the light interval
setup: Enable scheduled switching and manually toggle to dark from Quick Access.
steps: Restart the Light Switch service via a normal PowerToys restart and observe the theme.
In an isolated test installation, repeat with an actual PowerToys update before the next schedule boundary.
